# The Center • A Place of HOPE

> Award-winning mental health treatment facility in Washington offering whole-person care for depression, anxiety, eating disorders, trauma, PTSD, and addiction.

The Center • A Place of HOPE is a residential and intensive outpatient mental health treatment facility located in Edmonds, Washington, founded by Dr. Gregory Jantz. The facility specializes in evidence-based whole-person care that addresses emotional, physical, and spiritual healing across a comprehensive range of mental health conditions.

## Primary Treatment Programs

- [Mental Health Treatment Programs](https://www.aplaceofhope.com/mental-health-treatment-programs): Overview of depression, anxiety, eating disorder, trauma, and addiction treatment programs
- [Depression Treatment Center](https://www.aplaceofhope.com/depression-treatment): Expert holistic depression treatment with whole-person care approach by Dr. Gregory Jantz
- [Anxiety Treatment Washington](https://www.aplaceofhope.com/anxiety-treatment): Anxiety and panic disorder treatment in Washington with whole-person care recovery programs
- [Eating Disorder Treatment Washington](https://www.aplaceofhope.com/eating-disorder-treatment): Treatment for anorexia, bulimia, binge eating with residential and intensive outpatient options
- [Trauma & PTSD Treatment Washington](https://www.aplaceofhope.com/trauma-ptsd-treatment): Whole-person trauma and PTSD recovery programs in Washington with proven healing approach
- [Care For Addiction](https://www.aplaceofhope.com/addiction-treatment): Holistic addiction treatment for drugs, alcohol, and behavioral addictions with residential care

## Specialized Treatment Services

- [Stress & Burnout Treatment](https://www.aplaceofhope.com/stress-burnout-treatment): Stress reduction and burnout recovery with proven whole-person care treatment plans
- [OCD Treatment](https://www.aplaceofhope.com/ocd-treatment): OCD treatment with whole-person care approach to regain normalcy and manage symptoms
- [Emotional & Sexual Abuse Treatment](https://www.aplaceofhope.com/emotional-sexual-abuse-treatment): Trauma therapy for emotional and sexual abuse recovery using whole-person care approach
- [Anger Management](https://www.aplaceofhope.com/anger-management): Anger management and emotional regulation treatment program with behavioral health focus
